name: video_id
label: pitch
description: Video id of the pitch; the unit all rows of a pitch share.

name: source
label: record source
description: reviewed when the features come from the human-reviewed record, primary when model-coded.

name: cut_pos
label: history cut
description: Turn position at which this row's history stops; never a predictor.

name: founder_gender
label: founder gender
description: Venture control: founder gender (categorical).

name: primary_industry
label: primary industry
description: Venture control: primary industry (categorical).

name: product_form
label: product form
description: Venture control: product form (categorical).

name: customer_type
label: customer type
description: Venture control: customer type (categorical).

name: ask_log_amount
label: ask amount (log10 USD)
description: Base-10 logarithm of the amount in US dollars the founders asked for; missing when the ask is not recorded or is 0.

name: ask_equity_pct
label: ask equity (%)
description: Equity in percent the founders offered for the amount asked; missing when the ask is not recorded.

name: ask_missing
label: ask not recorded
description: 1 when the record gives no ask (the venture's ask_missing is not 'none'), else 0.

name: hist_turns
label: turns in the history
description: Eligible turns before the cut.

name: hist_seconds
label: seconds in the history
description: Summed duration of the eligible turns before the cut.

name: hist_questions
label: questions in the history
description: Question turns by investors before the cut (the questions family adds no second count of them).

name: demo_seconds
label: demonstration seconds
description: Summed duration of the eligible `demonstrates` turns before the cut, whoever speaks them (read from the turn function, not the exchange kind).

name: prepared_seconds
label: prepared presentation seconds
description: Length of the prepared presentation.

name: sa_pitch_positivity
label: Stage A pitch_positivity
description: Stage A rating of the prepared presentation on pitch_positivity (1-5); missing when uncodable.

name: sa_pitch_positivity_missing
label: Stage A pitch_positivity: not rated
description: 1 when sa_pitch_positivity is missing, else 0.

name: sa_expressed_enthusiasm
label: Stage A expressed_enthusiasm
description: Stage A rating of the prepared presentation on expressed_enthusiasm (1-5); missing when uncodable.

name: sa_expressed_enthusiasm_missing
label: Stage A expressed_enthusiasm: not rated
description: 1 when sa_expressed_enthusiasm is missing, else 0.

name: sa_interpersonal_warmth
label: Stage A interpersonal_warmth
description: Stage A rating of the prepared presentation on interpersonal_warmth (1-5); missing when uncodable.

name: sa_interpersonal_warmth_missing
label: Stage A interpersonal_warmth: not rated
description: 1 when sa_interpersonal_warmth is missing, else 0.

name: sa_rank_pitch_positivity
label: Stage A rank score pitch_positivity
description: Plackett-Luce score of the pitch on pitch_positivity from the batch ranking; present only when the run has rank scores.

name: sa_rank_expressed_enthusiasm
label: Stage A rank score expressed_enthusiasm
description: Plackett-Luce score of the pitch on expressed_enthusiasm from the batch ranking; present only when the run has rank scores.

name: sa_rank_interpersonal_warmth
label: Stage A rank score interpersonal_warmth
description: Plackett-Luce score of the pitch on interpersonal_warmth from the batch ranking; present only when the run has rank scores.

name: pres_subs
label: prepared presentation PRES-SUBS
description: The prepared presentation's PRES-SUBS rating, rated once per pitch; missing when not rated.

name: pres_subs_missing
label: prepared presentation PRES-SUBS: not rated
description: 1 when pres_subs is missing, else 0.

name: pres_coh
label: prepared presentation PRES-COH
description: The prepared presentation's PRES-COH rating, rated once per pitch; missing when not rated.

name: pres_coh_missing
label: prepared presentation PRES-COH: not rated
description: 1 when pres_coh is missing, else 0.

name: pres_ctx
label: prepared presentation PRES-CTX
description: The prepared presentation's PRES-CTX rating, rated once per pitch; missing when not rated.

name: pres_ctx_missing
label: prepared presentation PRES-CTX: not rated
description: 1 when pres_ctx is missing, else 0.

name: pres_evid
label: prepared presentation PRES-EVID
description: The prepared presentation's PRES-EVID rating, rated once per pitch; missing when not rated.

name: pres_evid_missing
label: prepared presentation PRES-EVID: not rated
description: 1 when pres_evid is missing, else 0.

name: q_askers
label: questioners
description: Distinct investors who asked a question.

name: q_sev_mean
label: severity of questions
description: Mean severity of investor questions.

name: q_sev_mean_n
label: severity of questions: observations
description: Number of rated observations behind q_sev_mean.

name: q_sev_mean_missing
label: severity of questions: none observed
description: 1 when q_sev_mean has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: q_hard_share
label: hard questions (share)
description: Share of the investor questions with a severity rating that ask for substantiation or contest a claim (severity 2 or 3); a question without a severity rating is left out of the denominator.

name: q_hard_share_n
label: hard questions (share): observations
description: Number of rated observations behind q_hard_share.

name: q_hard_share_missing
label: hard questions (share): none observed
description: 1 when q_hard_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: q_frame_promotion_share
label: promotion-framed questions (share)
description: Share of investor questions whose concept is promotion-framed. The denominator is every investor question before the cut, whatever its concept or frame, so the four question shares need not sum to 1 (a question with no concept counts only in the denominator).

name: q_frame_promotion_share_n
label: promotion-framed questions (share): observations
description: Number of rated observations behind q_frame_promotion_share.

name: q_frame_promotion_share_missing
label: promotion-framed questions (share): none observed
description: 1 when q_frame_promotion_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: q_frame_prevention_share
label: prevention-framed questions (share)
description: Share of investor questions whose concept is prevention-framed. The denominator is every investor question before the cut, whatever its concept or frame, so the four question shares need not sum to 1 (a question with no concept counts only in the denominator).

name: q_frame_prevention_share_n
label: prevention-framed questions (share): observations
description: Number of rated observations behind q_frame_prevention_share.

name: q_frame_prevention_share_missing
label: prevention-framed questions (share): none observed
description: 1 when q_frame_prevention_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: q_deal_terms_share
label: questions about the deal terms (share)
description: Share of investor questions whose concept is deal_terms. The denominator is every investor question before the cut, whatever its concept or frame, so the four question shares need not sum to 1 (a question with no concept counts only in the denominator).

name: q_deal_terms_share_n
label: questions about the deal terms (share): observations
description: Number of rated observations behind q_deal_terms_share.

name: q_deal_terms_share_missing
label: questions about the deal terms (share): none observed
description: 1 when q_deal_terms_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: q_other_share
label: questions about a matter outside the sixteen concepts (other) (share)
description: Share of investor questions whose concept is other. The denominator is every investor question before the cut, whatever its concept or frame, so the four question shares need not sum to 1 (a question with no concept counts only in the denominator).

name: q_other_share_n
label: questions about a matter outside the sixteen concepts (other) (share): observations
description: Number of rated observations behind q_other_share.

name: q_other_share_missing
label: questions about a matter outside the sixteen concepts (other) (share): none observed
description: 1 when q_other_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: q_sev_trend
label: severity trend of questions
description: Mean severity of the later half of the investor questions before the cut, in turn order, minus the mean of the earlier half (with an odd number the middle question is in neither half); questions without a severity rating are left out. 0.0 with fewer than two rated questions; `_n` counts the rated questions and `_missing` is 1 when there is none (the value is then 0.0, not missing).

name: q_sev_trend_n
label: severity trend of questions: observations
description: Number of investor questions with a severity rating behind q_sev_trend.

name: q_sev_trend_missing
label: severity trend of questions: none observed
description: 1 when no investor question before the cut has a severity rating (q_sev_trend is then 0.0, not missing), else 0.

name: q_pursuit_share
label: same-asker pursuit (share)
description: Share of consecutive pairs of investor questions before the cut, in turn order, in which the same investor asks both and the second has a strictly higher severity; pairs where either question has no severity rating are left out. Missing with no such pair (one question or none).

name: q_pursuit_share_n
label: same-asker pursuit (share): observations
description: Number of consecutive question pairs, both with a severity rating, behind q_pursuit_share.

name: q_pursuit_share_missing
label: same-asker pursuit (share): none observed
description: 1 when q_pursuit_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: q_frame_switch_share
label: frame switches (share)
description: Share of consecutive pairs of investor questions before the cut, in turn order, whose frames differ, among the pairs where both frames are promotion or prevention (a question about deal terms, about another matter or with no concept is never counted as a switch, and its pairs are left out). Missing with no such pair.

name: q_frame_switch_share_n
label: frame switches (share): observations
description: Number of consecutive question pairs, both promotion or prevention, behind q_frame_switch_share.

name: q_frame_switch_share_missing
label: frame switches (share): none observed
description: 1 when q_frame_switch_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: q_concept_entropy
label: concept diversity (entropy, bits)
description: Shannon entropy, in bits, of the concepts of the investor questions before the cut, over the questions with a concept (deal_terms and other count as concepts; a question with no concept, NONE, is left out). 0.0 when every such question has the same concept; missing with none.

name: q_concept_entropy_n
label: concept diversity (entropy, bits): observations
description: Number of investor questions with a concept behind q_concept_entropy.

name: q_concept_entropy_missing
label: concept diversity (entropy, bits): none observed
description: 1 when q_concept_entropy has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: a_resp_mean
label: answer directness (mean)
description: Mean responsiveness of the answers (addresses 1, partial 0.5, deflects 0), before the cut.

name: a_resp_mean_n
label: answer directness (mean): observations
description: Number of rated observations behind a_resp_mean.

name: a_resp_mean_missing
label: answer directness (mean): none observed
description: 1 when a_resp_mean has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: a_evid_share_n
label: answers with checkable support (share): observations

name: a_evid_share_missing
label: answers with checkable support (share): none observed
description: 1 when a_evid_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: a_uncert_share

name: a_uncert_share_n
label: answers admitting uncertainty (share): observations
description: Number of rated observations behind a_uncert_share.

name: a_uncert_share_missing
label: answers admitting uncertainty (share): none observed
description: 1 when a_uncert_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: a_subs_mean
label: answer substance (mean)
description: Mean substance rating of the answers, before the cut.

name: a_subs_mean_n
label: answer substance (mean): observations
description: Number of rated observations behind a_subs_mean.

name: a_subs_mean_missing
label: answer substance (mean): none observed

name: a_coh_mean

name: a_coh_mean_n
label: answer coherence (mean): observations

name: a_coh_mean_missing
label: answer coherence (mean): none observed

name: a_ctx_mean
label: answer contextualisation (mean)
description: Mean context rating of the answers, before the cut.

name: a_ctx_mean_n
label: answer contextualisation (mean): observations

name: a_ctx_mean_missing
label: answer contextualisation (mean): none observed
description: 1 when a_ctx_mean has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: a_subs_hard_mean
label: answer substance (mean), hard questions
description: Mean substance rating of the answers to investor hard questions (severity 2 or 3), before the cut.

name: a_subs_hard_mean_n
label: answer substance (mean), hard questions: observations
description: Number of rated observations behind a_subs_hard_mean.

name: a_subs_hard_mean_missing
label: answer substance (mean), hard questions: none observed

label: answers with checkable support (share), hard questions
description: Share of the answers to investor hard questions (severity 2 or 3) that give evidence, before the cut.

name: a_evid_hard_share_n
label: answers with checkable support (share), hard questions: observations
description: Number of rated observations behind a_evid_hard_share.

name: a_evid_hard_share_missing
label: answers with checkable support (share), hard questions: none observed
description: 1 when a_evid_hard_share has no observation and is missing, else 0.

name: a_frame_match_share
label: frame match of answers
description: Share of answers whose frame matches the question's, among answers where both frames are promotion or prevention.

name: a_frame_match_share_n

description: Number of rated observations behind a_frame_match_share.

name: a_frame_match_share_missing
label: frame match of answers: none observed
